title: Tuesday, October 6 — Shape of the Day
arrival: Tuesday, October 6 — Shape of the Day
note: Attendance before Terry Fox form collection. Laptop work ends at 10:20 for saving, putting laptops away and snack. After recess, the class chooses maths, community reflection or Nevermoor. Continue unfinished work in the afternoon. Mr. Eckert teaches French from 12:35–1:35.

blocks.title: Welcome, attendance and Terry Fox forms
blocks.notes: Take attendance, then collect Terry Fox permission forms.
studentSteps: Answer attendance, then hand in your Terry Fox form.

blocks.title: Laptop work block
blocks.notes: Work on teacher-directed laptop tasks; continue work already underway.
blocks.firstAction: Get your laptop ready and open the task your teacher identifies.
blocks.firstActionKo: 노트북을 준비하고 선생님이 안내한 활동을 여세요.

blocks.title: Save work, put laptops away and snack
blocks.notes: Save work and put laptops away before snack.
blocks.firstAction: Save your work, put your laptop away and have your snack.
blocks.firstActionKo: 작업을 저장하고 노트북을 정리한 뒤 간식을 먹으세요.

blocks.title: Class choice: maths, community reflection or Nevermoor
blocks.notes: Choose maths, community reflection or Nevermoor together. For maths, continue from the actual class stopping point; for Nevermoor, use the actual bookmark.
blocks.firstAction: Help choose maths, community reflection or Nevermoor, then get ready for our choice.
blocks.titleKo: 학급 선택: 수학, 학급 돌아보기 또는 Nevermoor
blocks.firstActionKo: 수학, 학급 돌아보기, Nevermoor 중 함께 활동을 고르고 준비하세요.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.notes: Usual intermediate routine: outside 11:50–12:12; transition 12:12–12:13; eating 12:13–12:35.
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.
blocks.firstActionKo: 바깥 놀이와 점심시간에는 정해진 순서대로 하세요.

blocks.title: French with Mr. Eckert
blocks.notes: French-only specialist block with Mr. Eckert; this is Mr. Wyatt’s prep. Classroom health learning and PE are taught by Mr. Wyatt.
blocks.firstAction: Get your French materials ready and follow Mr. Eckert’s directions.
blocks.firstActionKo: 프랑스어 준비물을 꺼내고 Eckert 선생님의 안내를 따르세요.

blocks.title: Quiet reset
blocks.notes: Preserve a calm reset; a quiet non-reading choice is available.
blocks.firstAction: Choose quiet reading, drawing or an unfinished task.
blocks.firstActionKo: 조용히 책 읽기, 그림 그리기, 끝내지 못한 활동 중 하나를 고르세요.

blocks.title: Work block: continue unfinished work
blocks.notes: Continue unfinished class work. Identify one next step and leave a clear stopping point.
blocks.firstAction: Take out unfinished work and choose your next step.
blocks.titleKo: 활동 시간: 끝내지 못한 활동 이어서 하기
blocks.firstActionKo: 끝내지 못한 활동을 꺼내고 다음에 할 일을 고르세요.

blocks.title: Cleanup, planners and community time
blocks.notes: Clean up, record confirmed planner reminders, then share a brief community check-in or appreciation.
blocks.firstAction: Tidy your space, complete your planner and join community time.
blocks.firstActionKo: 자리를 정리하고 알림장을 쓴 뒤 학급 활동에 참여하세요.

blocks.title: Dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and get ready for a calm departure.
blocks.firstActionKo: 자기 물건을 확인하고 차분히 하교할 준비를 하세요.

backups: Carry unfinished learning into the next suitable block rather than adding a second full lesson.
If the projector or sign-in fails, use paper, the board and available class materials.
